beats.say: Turn over a rock in a tide pool, and a tiny octopus flashes blue rings at you.
That's a warning. Its bite can kill a human.
The blue-ringed octopus. One of the most venomous animals in the world.
Its venom is a nerve toxin, called tetrodotoxin.
A four year old bitten at a Queensland beach couldn't stand, within ten minutes.
Would Meatball survive? Yes, on a breathing machine. The boy needed seventeen hours, then went home fine.
